title: Brand
description: A brand of FElupe Studio (ADR 0020): the brand.json of a brand folder, given at build time with BRAND_DIR. The default brand is app/brand.

$schema.description: The JSON schema of the file, for editors.

brand_version.description: The version of this schema. An addition keeps it; a change that is not additive raises it.

name.description: The name of the app: the title of the page, the header, the welcome panel and the texts of the app.

short_name.description: A short name, e.g. below the icon of an installed app.

logo.description: The logo, an SVG file of the brand folder: the header, the favicon and the manifest.

icons.description: The icons of an installed app, PNG files of the brand folder of 192 × 192 and 512 × 512 px, e.g. made from the logo by app/scripts/make_icons.py; without them, the manifest has the logo only.

storage.description: The prefix of the browser storage of the app: the keys <storage>.<name>, the session <storage>, the bytecode cache and the cache of the service worker. Two brands on one origin keep their data apart; felupe-studio is that of FElupe Studio.

accent.description: The accent color of the app, e.g. of buttons and selections, as #rrggbb; without it, the color of FElupe Studio.

welcome.description: The text below the title of the welcome panel.

links.description: The links of the app. help, issues and source are required: a brand inherits no links of FElupe Studio.

help.description: Help ▸ User guide and the welcome panel.

documentation.description: Help ▸ Command reference; without it, no item.

tutorial.description: The tutorial of the welcome panel; without it, no link.

source.description: The source of the deployed version (the GPL asks for it): Help ▸ About ▸ Source code.

samples.description: The folder of the samples of the brand (#350), relative to the brand folder; without it, the brand has no samples.

pyodide.description: Where the app loads Pyodide from: cdn (cdn.jsdelivr.net, the default), or self-hosted: the build copies Pyodide and its packages into the app, which then needs no internet access.

units.description: The units of the model settings of a new model (#132).
